scope: Selected original RA2 Unit-class passenger unloading mission and its actual timer dispatch. Not the miner, aircraft or garrison branches.

observations.blockedAdmissionOrUnlimboFailure: Reinsert passenger, retain count and retry at the common mission rate.
observations.noInitialExit: Queue Guard instead of popping a passenger.
observations.finish: After the release dispatch observes empty cargo, stage4 subsequently queues Guard and marks completion; both use the common rate.
observations.interrupt: A real immediate Move queue at native frame3 changes current mission to Move and retains two passengers, for all three seeds.

limits: Original physical placement, map/pathfinding geometry, actual locomotor turn progression, full object construction and full user-click frame alignment are not established.
